rationale: The repeated step-and-reversal response, with other inputs fixed and no disturbances, licenses a two-hour reduction in settled delay at the tested operating point. This bounded claim requires no identification of internal stages or unique internal cause.

signal_basis.exact_text: The measured output is end-to-end delay in hours.
Each of three repetitions settles from five hours to three hours after the step and returns to five hours after reversal.
No other input changes or disturbances occur during these observations.
The delay measurement is calibrated and all trajectories settle inside the window.
